item.description:
Cubby 1.0.8 removes an unwanted blank Settings window.
- Fixes the empty “Cubby Settings” window that could appear while using the app. - Preserves standard editing shortcuts, including copy, paste, and undo.
Your notes, clipboard history, and screenshots stay in place.

Cubby 1.0.7 improves opening from the menu bar.
- Brings hidden or unfocused panels forward when you click the menu bar icon. - Improves panel behavior across desktops and full-screen spaces. - Keeps the panel on screen when using multiple monitors or changing display configurations. - Clears stale panel visibility after sleep and desktop changes.
Includes the existing first-time setup and in-app updater. Your notes and screenshots stay in place.

A clearer first-time experience for Cubby.
- A dedicated setup window explains clipboard access and the screenshot folder in two simple steps, with clear indicators when each is ready. - When capture is already ready, Cubby opens directly to your feed. - New installations automatically save macOS screenshots in Pictures → Cubby instead of on the Desktop. If the folder changes or becomes unavailable later, Capture Setup helps you reconnect it. - Clipboard guidance reflects the access allowed by macOS and helps you recover when access needs attention. - Simpler empty states feature animated Little Grizzly with a clipboard, camera, or pencil. All three tabs keep Grizzly and the text aligned while switching. Screenshots says only: “Screenshots are saved here automatically.”
Your existing notes, clipboard history, and screenshots remain saved.
Choose **Check for Updates…** in Cubby’s three-dot menu to install this release. Users on the original Cubby 1.0 need to download and install the DMG manually once.
Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later. Supports Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
